title: Integration tests: one template per run, one clone per file
caption: packages/testing/src/vitest-global-setup.ts and test-database.ts. Role velexis_test_admin exists only locally and in CI (dev-setup.sh), never on the VM.

steps.label: CREATE DATABASE velexis_test_tpl_<runId> OWNER velexis_migrator + database grants
schemas.sql; runMigrations platform + reference; migrateTenantSchema tenant_alpha, tenant_beta (create)
REFERENCE_FIXTURE as velexis_platform_app (EUR GBP USD, FR GB US, CDG ORY LHR JFK LAX, AF BA AA)
throwaway _flush database create + drop (forces a checkpoint)
CREATE DATABASE velexis_test_<runId>_<random> TEMPLATE … + grants again (0.1–0.4 s)
ALLOW_CONNECTIONS false; each app role terminates its own sessions; DROP DATABASE … WITH (FORCE); retry
teardown: drop left-over clones of this run, then the template
